title: Apply the actual decision policy
when: Before presenting or recording a decision, especially when multiple people or roles must approve.
need: Any-one and all-required policies differ. An agent must inspect the typed request and current policy; one generic approve command cannot settle all decision kinds.
surface: Workflow approval explanation; lifecycle gate; run-only Approve skill
gap: Review question: should Help route approve this from the actual pending request instead of leaving the user to guess the command?
